component_selection.n_components_status: temporary exploration baseline; update these panel values after nc= review
component_selection.labels_and_orientations: not specified here; use the optional post-fit description JSON

weighting.score_normalization: divide each fitted PC score by its training SD (singular_value / sqrt(n_fit - 1))
weighting.contract_status: implemented by the HDSTATS-PC fitting and JSON projection code

terminology.domain: A top-level PC family (e.g. W, N2, NR, TR, UL).
terminology.component: A conceptual subclass within a domain; component weight groups receive equal total weight.

stage_rules.W_R_NR: Use NSS=3 hard-called stage conditioning. Stable/unstable refinements are included only here and remain part of LOCAL_INSTABILITY.
stage_rules.N2_N3: Use ordinary NSS=5 hard-called stage conditioning. Do not use stable/unstable refinements.
stage_rules.N1: Use only posterior amount and soft long-range organization; exclude all N1 arg-max-conditioned and stable/unstable measures.
stage_rules.NR: Keep NR as a distinct NREM domain. Include its NSS=3 purity measures and NREM depth/composition features; N2 predominance within NR is expected.

stage_component_contract.weighting: Each listed component has equal input-variance budget within its domain. For G components and p_g measures in a component, use 1 / sqrt(G * p_g) per standardized measure; normalize fitted PC scores to unit training-sample variance.
